findings.description: Isabel Flores was born on 7 July 1880 and baptized on 11 July 1880 in the parish of San Pablo, Laguna, Philippines, the daughter of Policronio Flores and Catalina Ortiz.
supporting_sources: Philippines, Catholic Church Records, 1520-2014 — baptism entry for Isabel Flores, daughter of Policronio Flores and Catalina Ortiz, 11 Jul 1880
